## About us

Southwest Research Institute is an independent, nonprofit, applied research and development organization. The staff numbers approximately 3,200 professionals specializing in the creation and transfer of technology in engineering and the physical sciences. Research volume for fiscal year 2024 was $915 million. SwRI headquarters occupy more than 1,500 acres in San Antonio, Texas, and provide more than 2.4 million square feet of laboratories, test facilities, workshops, and offices. SwRI maintains technical offices and laboratories in Ann Arbor, Mich.; Boulder, Colo.; Hanover, Md.; Ogden, Utah; Minneapolis, Minn.; Oklahoma City; Warner Robins, Ga.; and Durham, N.H.
SwRI is an independent organization. Likes, follows, and shares do not imply endorsements.

* [Southwest Research Institute](https://www.linkedin.com/company/southwest-research-institute?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card_feed-reaction-header) reposted this

    + [Report this post](https://www.linkedin.com/uas/login?fromSignIn=true&session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fsouthwest-research-institute&trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card_ellipsis-menu-semaphore-sign-in-redirect&guestReportContentType=POST&_f=guest-reporting)
  
  Four satellites, one mission.
  Two weeks ago, I had an incredible opportunity to further my understanding of space plasma physics through the Magnetospheric MultiScale mission, which is driven by [NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration](https://www.linkedin.com/company/nasa?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) , [NASA Goddard Space Flight Center](https://www.linkedin.com/company/nasa-goddard-space-flight-center?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) , and the [Southwest Research Institute](https://www.linkedin.com/company/southwest-research-institute?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) . For almost a year, I have been collaborating with [Katariina Nykyri](https://www.linkedin.com/in/katariina-nykyri-27b4001?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) on this exciting project.
  At a conference hosted by my professor at [Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University](https://www.linkedin.com/school/embry-riddle-aeronautical-university/?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) , I had the chance to reconnect with one of my mentors from my internship at APL, [Savvas Raptis](https://www.linkedin.com/in/savvas-raptis?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) . I also met many individuals who are actively contributing to this remarkable mission and making groundbreaking discoveries in [\#space](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fspace&trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) physics. This experience provided me with valuable insights into new research and upcoming missions, including the [University of Iowa](https://www.linkedin.com/school/university-of-iowa/?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) Tracer mission. Thank you to the plasma physics community for welcoming me! [\#NASA](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fnasa&trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) [\#MMS](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fmms&trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) [\#plasmaphysics](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fplasmaphysics&trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) [\#physics](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fphysics&trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) [\#spaceplasmaphysics](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fspaceplasmaphysics&trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text) [\#magnetohydrodynamics](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fmagnetohydrodynamics&trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text)
